A Galois-Theoretic and Frobenius-Descent Viewpoint on a Polynomial Composition Law

A second approach to the separated-polynomial composition criterion, using Galois theory and reduction in positive characteristic.

Generic fibers and descent give another way to understand the composition law. The positive-characteristic part isolates the role of Frobenius. Read this alongside Divisibility of Separated Polynomials.

Background

Galois theory and polynomials in positive characteristic.
